title: Your Weekly Horoscopes by Madame Clairevoyant: September 27-October 3
text:
As Mars enters Leo, now’s the time to take big swings.

Good things will come to those brave enough to bet on themselves. Then, on Wednesday morning,, where it’ll stay until early December. If the people around you suddenly seem less polite and more provocative, the best way to deal with them is to match their energy. Don’t bend over backward to avoid awkward moments.
Finally, early Saturday morning,begins a six-week retrograde that starts in Scorpio before backtracking into Libra. During this time, reflect on your values and relationships. If you realize you have some regrets, you might now get a second chance to set things right. In theory, you know the best way to tackle a big project is to break it into smaller chunks.
That way, you never have too much to deal with at once; you won’t be left scrambling to finish everything right before the deadline. But keeping to a steady pace is easier said than done. Whether because of external obstacles or your own wavering energy levels, linear progress isn’t always possible. This week, try to make the most of the big bursts of energy when they come so you can take it easy when you’re feeling less motivated.
You’re caring and loyal. You’d do practically anything to protect the people you love. If you see a friend being mistreated, you’ll stand up for them without a second thought. You’re not always so quick, though, to defendInstead, you’re inclined to self-criticize, telling yourself you’re being overdramatic, making a big deal out of nothing.
Deep down, you believe people must have a good reason if they’re being rude to you. But this week, stop accepting less than you deserve. Stand up for yourself the same way you would for someone you love. Putting all your eggs in one basket tends to make you antsy; you’re happier when you have multiple projects in the works.
The trouble is some people interpret your many spinning plates as a sign you’re unfocused — if you were actuallyyou’d go all in on one goal and forget the rest! Maybe you’ve tried to do things their way, homing in on a single objective … with varying levels of success. This week, though, give yourself permission to do thingsway. At least right now, there’s no point in narrowing your focus if variety is what will make you happy.
Usually, you don’t worry much about conventional markers of success. You don’t need to amass wealth to believe you have value; you don’t need accolades and awards to know you’re smart and hardworking.
Nevertheless, this week, you might start to doubt yourself. You may realize you wantexternal validation — some tangible sign you haven’t been wasting your time. There’s nothing wrong with pursuing praise right now if that’s what you want. But remind yourself that regardless of whether you get it, that praise has no bearing on your fundamental worth as a human being.
Sometimes, you’re wary of making your goals too obvious. Maybe you fear you’ll come across as pushy and self-centered. Maybe you worry that other people, motivated by jealousy or greed, will make it their mission to get in your way. And it’s true that on some occasions, it’s best to take an indirect route toward your objective.
But not this week. Right now, there’s no reason to make things more complicated: Be blunt about what you want and what you need. Maybe some people will find you overbearing or difficult, but their judgment shouldn’t be enough to stop you. You don’t want to be the sort of person who’s always self-promoting, angling for more attention.
You’d rather focus on the task at hand than on earning praise for your performance. The satisfaction of a job well done should suffice, you imagine. But that’s probably notrealistic. It’s normal to want recognition — and normal to get frustrated when you feel overlooked.
This week, make sure you’re not setting yourself up for disappointment by beingWhen your plans don’t immediately pay off, you often assume you’ve done something wrong: Perhaps you didn’t work hard enough or your strategy was flawed from the beginning. Still, while it’s good to own up to your mistakes, there’s a chance you’re beingquick to take responsibility — or to assume failure. Some plans simply take longer to come to fruition. If you’re patient, you might have more success.
This week, focus on the long game rather than on any short-term hurdles. It’s important to be willing to question authority. Everyone gets things wrong sometimes, even the people who claim to have all the answers. But this week, be careful not to beeager to pick fights with authority figures.
At the very least, think things through before you go on the offensive. Some battles aren’t worth it, and sometimes the timing isn’t right. If you act recklessly, you’ll only end up making your life harder — and you’ll end up with little to show for your efforts.you’re right about something important, you might feel a duty to make everyone around you see the light, too.
You believe that if you sit down and explain your thinking, they’ll have no choice but to see things your way; if you present your case clearly or forcefully enough, they’llit. But the harder you push this week, the more resistant others will be. Give people space to make up their own minds. If your case is as strong as you think, they’ll probably come around in time.
This week, it might seem as if the people around you are constantly competing for attention. Everyone is talking just to hear the sound of their own voice, desperate to ensure nobodygets too much time in the spotlight. Rather than enter the fray yourself, hold back — you might find doing so surprisingly powerful. Don’t feel pressured to speak up simply because you’re afraid of being left out.
If you wait until you actually have something important to say, others are more likely to listen. When the people you love express dissatisfaction with some aspect of your relationship, you struggle not to take it personally. You feel that they’re criticizing you toyou. But in reality, it’s probably the opposite.
If they didn’t care about your connection, they’d simply let it wither away or they’d allow problems to grow and fester. The fact that they’re saying something now is proof they value your bond. Do your best to listen to what they have to say and resolve the conflict together. This week, you’ll be motivated to help those around you, even if nobody has asked for your assistance.
Some people might even insist that they’re fine, that they don’t need or want your help. You know better. Still, while your intentions are good, convincing yourself you understand others’ problems better than they do will only complicate your relationships. People don’t like feeling unheard and talked over.
